HOW TO WEAVE A SOUND

Your hands leave.
The crossing stays.

Listen, then drag a pearl across its neighbour. Hold Shift to pass underneath, or use the four crossing keys below. Drag the empty space to turn the sculpture; scroll to move closer.

A and B exchange neighbouring strands. Their order changes the chord’s colour. An inverse crossing restores its previous timbral state. Undo unwinds your last gesture; Unweave returns to the beginning.

AB ≠ BA
ABA = BAB

These are matrices from the Fibonacci representation of the braid group. They redistribute the amplitudes and phases of twelve partials. Equivalent braids reach the same final timbre; their journeys can sound different.

The three colours follow strand identity. The ribbon is your score, growing downward through time. Spectral flowers respond to the sound. Enter the braid to hear the voices around you.
